exposure: Attendance at a multidisciplinary IBD clinic (IBD MOM) vs. standard care
cohort: 306 pregnant women with IBD, 90 attending the IBD MOM clinic and 206 attending standard antenatal and gastrointestinal disease community clinics
finding: Women with moderate and severe IBD who attended a multidisciplinary clinic had a higher rate of preterm delivery but may benefit from the specialized care.
mod_finding: Rates of labor induction were similar between the IBD MOM group and the IBD GI group.
birth_weight: Mentioned as similar between groups, but no specific weight range provided
